text: {"lessons":["Selling after a gain has felt satisfying, but being above my cost basis alone is not a sound reason to sell; compare each holding’s prospects and portfolio role.","I have sold winners and later bought some back. Since past price moves do not predict future ones, avoid reacting to recent gains or losses as if they signal what comes next.","My tendency to judge each stock against its purchase price can make losses feel unusually painful and gains unusually rewarding. Make decisions based on portfolio-wide risk, diversification, and future prospects instead."]}
